cards.text: In the game: the cobra's hood circles over its coil, the spirits' tails wiggle, the gaper's line is thinner.
cards.why: You wrote: "have it slowly move around the bottom segment in game", "like that rat tail" and "the gaper in this pic has big outlines". The gaper stands beside a rattler: their lines are the same weight now. Pin anything that looks wrong.

cards.title: Wolves: heads, bodies
cards.text: The game's wolves: no paws, heads forward, bodies shorter. Beside them: the paws drawn under the body.
cards.why: You wrote: "Bring their heads forwards a bit. Shorten body a bit. And I think this is good. Also show me with the pawns rendering under the body" The three without paws are live. Comment with the one to keep, or what to change. The game keeps its current art until you pick.
